knownLimitations: Current Poșta Română pages establish periodically updated search and six-digit assignment semantics, but not a fixed current complete assignment/exception artifact or compatible AGID processing, derivation, storage, redistribution and public-serving permission.

Infocod is controlled through a prior written request/monthly handoff and ANCOM Decision 810/2024 describes civil-contract access for third-party postal providers; neither is treated as an open public-serving grant.
The operator no-GPS statement is dated and may be superseded by a newer exact release. No such fixed authoritative postcode-area release was identified or validated in this run.
Direct data.gov.ro catalogue API and ANCPI address-task requests failed twice each in this environment. This is availability evidence only and no non-existence claim is made.
No county, UAT, locality, SIRUTA, RENNS address point, ANCPI parcel/building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell or synthetic fixture was promoted.

Relevant PDF pages rendered successfully with Poppler and extractable pages were checked with pdfplumber. Local PNG display failed with Windows error 206, so image-viewer verification is not claimed; ANCOM text was corroborated through the official web reader.

The isolated worktree reused an existing read-only dependency tree through a temporary junction. Standard typecheck then lacked six workspace symlinks; a temporary tsconfig mapped the six package names to their declared local src/index.ts public entries, and the full graph passed.
No real RO postcode runtime, API map fit, translucent rendering or browser E2E can be exercised without an approved fixed reconciled artifact.
